itemUsage.en: A wanderer from a Kazimierzian knight family, Młynar, with his sword always resting by his side.
itemUsage.zh: 卡西米尔骑士家族的漫游者，玛恩纳，始终将剑带在身边。

itemDesc.en: He exhorts all to flee Kazimierz, yet never left himself.
itemDesc.zh: 他劝诫所有人逃离卡西米尔，而自己从未离开。

description.en:
Attack interval <@ba.vdown>increased</>, attack range <@ba.vup>increased</>, attacks deal <@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale:0%}</> ATK <@ba.vup>twice</>.
<@ba.rem>If an enemy has been defeated while skill is active, Trait effect is not reset when skill expires. This can be manually deactivated. (Skill can be halted at any time while active)</>
description.zh: 攻击间隔<@ba.vdown>延长</>，攻击范围<@ba.vup>扩大</>，攻击造成相当于<@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale:0%}</>攻击力的<@ba.vup>二</>连击。\n<@ba.rem>技能期间若击倒敌人，技能结束时特性效果不重置，可主动关闭（期间可随时停止技能）</>

description.en: Attack range <@ba.vup>increased</>, Trait effect increased by <@ba.vup>{trait_up}</>x (trait multiplier <@ba.vup>{per_kill_reduce:0%}</> for each enemy defeated), attacks hit <@ba.vup>{attack@max_target}</> targets for <@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as Physical damage. When any enemy within range is attacked by a Kazimierz Operator, deal an extra <@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</> of Młynar ATK as <@ba.vup>True</> damage.
description.zh: 攻击范围<@ba.vup>扩大</>，特性提升至<@ba.vup>{trait_up}</>倍（每击倒一名敌人时特性倍率<@ba.vup>{per_kill_reduce:0%}</>），攻击对<@ba.vup>{attack@max_target}</>个目标造成相当于<@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale:0%}</>攻击力的物理伤害。范围内所有敌人受到卡西米尔干员攻击时额外附带玛恩纳<@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</>攻击力的<@ba.vup>真实</>伤害

description.en: The family motto engraved on the sword is near unreadable thanks to the many times I've put it to the grindstone... though it does not need sharpening at all, for it has not seen blood for far too long. I merely became accustomed to the practice. Every day—after replying to those summons, answering those letters, helping father wash his body, and putting the children to sleep—I would head down to the garage to sharpen it. How old were we when father gave us this sword to play with? He called you 'Little Nearl' while I was 'Littler Nearl', as if the first names he gave us were only for government identification. All he cared for was if we would be qualified to be 'Nearls'. After all, simply knowing you were a knight of the Nearl family would have shown you your path in life, in his time. But now? Remind me, where did the path we put so much trust in back then lead us? ...Alright, we've all changed. I became frustrated, and you became.... heh, silent. My interviewer today pulled me into a small meeting room afterward, and anxiously explained to me that those questions he asked were only part of the procedure. He seemed to believe that a longsword glowing with golden light would be falling upon his neck if he had offended me—after all, the Nearls in the papers are always depicted as arrogant, bloodthirsty, and indiscriminate 'envoys of justice'. But after a moment's hesitation, he ambivalently asked me if he could tell the Nearls' story to his child. For a man who works six-point-five days a week, whose brain has no room for anything other than work, he is left with only those third-rate radio dramas—the ones he listened to during commutes—to lull his child to sleep. That is, until he stumbled upon the 'knight stories' while conducting my background check. ...Pathetic? Perhaps. To tell his child knight tales he doesn't even believe in, only because those are the only decent stories he knows. But how can I deride him? How am I any different? After all, what drives me to sharpen this sword every day? I know well it cannot cut anything. ...Heh, I was afraid you wouldn't even recognize me now. Maria is nearly old enough to understand what is going on, to know what being a 'Nearl' signifies. She should not learn it through the lamentations of someone as disappointing as me. I will carry the sword on me. When the two children have grown up... I should wander once more. But for now, I want only to forget that I belong to the Nearl family. How did I never manage to notice what ordinary people usually occupy their eyes with? I have to fill this empty shell of mine with something. ...Though, it doesn't matter what I am filled with. Perhaps Młynar was merely thinking in silence, or perhaps he mumbled these words to himself. Thanks to the excellent soundproof car windows manufactured by Mieszko, no one heard a word he spoke in that underground garage. He silently returns the sword into its scabbard, and takes out a stack of newspapers that had previously acted as a seat cushion. He reads them without thinking, with no concern for their date, or where he had previously started or stopped reading. He fills himself with their words, like inflating a balloon man.
description.zh:
剑上刻的家训快被我磨得看不清了……但这柄剑其实已经太久没沾过血，根本不需要磨。我只是习惯了，每天应付完那些传唤，回复完那些信件，给父亲擦洗过身体，又哄孩子们睡着之后，下来车库里打磨它几下。
父亲把这柄剑拿给我们玩的时候，我们都才几岁？他管你叫“小临光”，管我叫“小小临光”，好像他自己给我们起的名字，就只是用来应付身份文件的。他只在乎我们能不能成为合格的“临光”。毕竟，在他的时代，只要知道自己是临光家的骑士，就算是已经看清了一生的道路。
但现在？提醒提醒我吧，我们当初那般坚信的道路，是指向何方？
……好吧，我们都变了。我变得失意，而你变得……呵，沉默了。
白天面试我的那个人，面试结束之后又拉我进小会议室，忧心忡忡地解释他在面试期间的一切问话都只是按章程办事。他似乎相信只要自己稍有冒犯，就会有一把闪着金光的长剑砍下他的脑袋——毕竟报纸上都说临光之名属于那些傲慢、嗜血、不分青红皂白的所谓“正义使者”。但支支吾吾一阵之后，他又隐晦地问我，愿不愿意他把临光家的故事，讲给他的孩子听。一个每周工作六天半的人，脑子里除了工作安排什么都没有，如果不是做背景调查的时候看到了些骑士故事，他能讲给孩子听的就只剩上下班路上听的那些三流的广播剧了。
……一个可笑的人？或许。把自己都不相信的骑士故事讲给孩子听，只因为这是他所知的，唯一还像样的故事。但我哪里能耻笑他？我又何尝不是如此，否则我何必每天打磨这柄剑？我明知道它什么都砍不断。
……呵，我真怕你都认不出我。
玛莉娅也快到懂事的年纪了。临光之名意味着什么，她不该从一个失意者的哀叹中体会。
剑我会带在身上。等那两个孩子都长大了……我还得再走一趟。但现在，我要是能忘了自己是个临光，才好。
我怎么没留意过普通人都看些什么？总得往我这具空壳子里填些什么。
……不过也是，填什么都无所谓。

这番话玛恩纳或许只在心里默念，又或许讲出了声——多亏梅什科出品的车窗隔音性能过硬，地下车库里没人听见。他沉默地将剑收回鞘中，又沉默地从身下翻出一叠用来垫车座的报纸，什么都没考虑便读了起来，无所谓它是何时的新闻，也无所谓从哪里读到哪里。把那些文字填入玛恩纳，就像灌满一个气球人。
